Voices from the team

"We place great emphasis on building foundational capabilities and cognition, believing that a solid foundation is key to continuous long-term improvement. We hope to not only lead but also to think about how to stay ahead."

Seed-Vision

"Our team has always been very pragmatic. We've not only achieved significant technological breakthroughs, but have also delivered numerous outcomes with tangible value."

Seed-AI for Science

"I think the biggest source of motivation for work is what we are doing is still at the forefront of the industry. If it's full of challenges, it also means that there are plenty of opportunities."

Seed-Multimodal

"We are one of the world's leading speech teams. Seeing our colleagues view some achievements dialectically, it has also enabled me to look at problems with higher standards."

Seed-Speech

"The team gave me a great platform to compete with top global research groups. Seed has given me the chance to shake up the status quo in terms of the ways of working in this field, and more opportunities to do disruptive work too."

Seed-Robotics

"The team has been a great support for me personally. The work of LLM cannot be perfected by one person alone; it requires cooperation and collaboration among colleagues in each sub-field."

Seed-LLM

"In our team, everyone is free and equal when we research and discuss things. We keep bouncing ideas off each other, sparking great insights and solid ideas that we then turn into reality."

Seed-Responsible AI

"I am looking forward to applying the Al knowledge and skills I've learned to real-world scenarios. The ability to tackle more challenging and fundamental problems is the main reason I joined."
